texts.zh:
我们的民族自古以来都是旅人、牧民和流浪者。有些人的旅行是到达目的地的一种手段，而我们的目的地就是旅行本身。身体强化改造使新的星球更加触手可及，但也使我们能够跟踪到那些太过离经叛道的人。就是说，并非所有人都对这种变化感到满意。

越来越多的人开始篡改自己的植入体，通过脱离网络以保护自己的隐私。目前这仅仅是一个小众趋势，但它可能会带来麻烦。
texts.en:
Our people have always been travelers. Nomads. Wanderers. While for some traveling is a means to reach a destination, for us the journey is a destination in itself. Body augmentation has made it easier to reach new worlds, but has also allowed us to track those who may stray too far. Not everyone is happy with this change.

An increasing number of people have been tampering with their implants, dropping themselves off the grid to preserve their privacy. For now it's a niche trend, but it could create trouble.

summary.text:
# 我心何向 / Where Our Hearts Will Take Us

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:4100-4216`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链中段：网络化局势结束后 cyber.500 选出 505–525 之一，约180+随机90天后隐藏事件 cyber.600 从 on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list（11个事件，权重各5：工作 610/615/625/655，家庭 805/810/815/820/830/840/855）抽取一个。
  Middle of the "Future Shock" event chain: after the Cyberization situation ends cyber.500 picks one of 505-525; about 180 days (+ random 90) later hidden cyber.600 draws one event from on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list (11 events, weight 5 each: work 610/615/625/655, family 805/810/815/820/830/840/855).
- 触发：拥有同时带“赛博格”与“游牧”特质的物种。
  Trigger: an owned species with both the Cybernetic and Nomadic traits.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「心之所向」：选项——cyber_wanderers 修正（巨型企业另有）；中性选项；追踪游民（cyber_wanderers_tracked，威权加成）。
  "Where Our Hearts Will Take Us": options: cyber_wanderers modifier (megacorp variant); a neutral option; tracking the wanderers (cyber_wanderers_tracked, authoritarian bonus).
- 选项后180+随机100天由 cyber.1000 衔接。
  Followed by cyber.1000 after 180 days (+ random 100).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
